name: Arctic Survival
description: Third non-Hyperia game plugin. Arctic-themed survival gameplay — depends on @hyperforge/combat for ability registry; contributes one utility ability ('frost-blast'), a TemperatureGauge HUD widget showing cold-exposure depletion, and arctic-survival entityTypes (heat_source, ice_block, frozen_cache). Pairs naturally with @hyperforge/content-pack-arctic-v1 for biomes + vegetation but does not require it (the plugin's contribution surface stands alone).

entityTypes.description: Campfire / brazier / stove that radiates warmth in a small radius. Pause cold exposure inside the heat radius.
Static ice formation. Mining yields water + cold-tier crafting material. Spawns near frozen_lake biomes.
Preserved loot stash beneath glacial ice — interact to thaw + claim. One-shot per spawn.
Quest-giver NPC. Marks survival objectives + sells cold-weather gear. Reads `storeId`.
